reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis invokes VEC and atomic size difference as governing factors, which are well-known empirical parameters for phase stability in high-entropy alloys, but it does not specify how they operate mechanistically in this specific alloy or why they would explain the range of phases observed, making it too generic.
reasons.testability: The proposed test involves varying VEC and atomic size difference in films, but the hypothesis is about a specific bulk alloy (Cr39Co18Fe18Ni18Al7) and its cooling behavior; changing composition to vary these parameters tests a different set of alloys, not the mechanism in the given alloy, so the test would not decisively falsify the hypothesis as stated.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis merely restates well-known empirical correlations (VEC, size difference) without offering a new, specific mechanistic insight into the phase selection during cooling of this particular alloy, so it provides little actionable guidance for a researcher working on this exact problem.
